enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $7,917 for Marzano Resources to train MetWest High School teachers on proficiency scales
enrichment.summary: Marzano Resources would lead four guided work sessions for MetWest High School teachers on proficiency scales, which are used to plan Professional Learning Community (PLC) discussions about mastery-based learning, and on choosing priority standards. Materials are included. The work ran February 2 through May 29, 2026, before this Board vote, and is capped at $7,917.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Provides immigrant and newcomer support training to county staff under a deal worth up to $300,000
enrichment.summary: The district would provide training, capacity-building and ongoing coaching to Alameda County Office of Education staff and to other Alameda County school districts on serving immigrant and newcomer students and families. The agreement runs July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027 with an amount not to exceed $300,000. The funding source is listed as the county office, so this appears to be money coming in to the district.
